entry.title: Oort NX 0.5.0-beta.4 — Find what you want to do
entry.content:
New

  • Search in one place

    Press ⌘K to find a game, a setting or an action. With a controller, open Find a game, then press Y.

  • Undo a removal

    You can put back a favorite or a Mac shortcut you just removed.

  • Copy a game’s settings

    See what will change before you copy settings to another game. You can also reset a single setting.

Better

  • Refresh everything together

    Refresh your games and online library at once. Activity shows what changed and what Oort couldn’t read.

  • Choose your Google Drive folders

    Setup helps you choose where to keep your games and their files. When you sign out, you can keep your Google ID and secret on this Mac. Your files stay on Drive.

  • Use the controls you prefer

    Switch between mouse, controller and keyboard. Right-click for options, and the buttons stay available if you hide the hints.

  • Choose where to see player counts

    In Settings › Multiplayer, choose where to show Nextendo’s player counts. Turn off all four options to stop looking up the counts.

Fixed

  • Online game archives

    Oort no longer reports a failure when a transfer finishes but its response arrives late.

Good to know

Try Frost, Mist or Nucleus in Settings › Sound. Your current choice stays the same. You can support Oort NX on Ko-fi in Settings › About; the Arcane credits are still there.

Coming from 0.3.0

Coming from 0.3.0? Install the DMG once. Oort copies your library and leaves the old one in place.

Finish any pending removals and installs in the old version. Don’t run both versions at once.

Not tried yet

This beta hasn’t been tried with a real controller, a real Google Drive transfer, a real game or on another Mac. Keep a copy of the data that matters to you.

Install

You need an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or later. Apple hasn’t checked this app. If macOS blocks the first launch, go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway. You don’t need to rebuild your games.

entry.title: Oort NX 0.1.0-alpha.3 — The same controls as on Mac
entry.content:
New

  • Control center

    Home or holding + opens it. + opens game options, Y searches and holding Home opens Settings.

  • Your controller’s controls

    Settings › Controllers › Controls shows Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro and Joy-Con layouts. Hints follow your last input.

  • Your installed games

    The Installed tab shows what you can play now. Drop a program or folder on the window to add it.

Better

  • Mouse and touch

    Scroll or swipe to choose, right-click or long-press for options. The on-screen keyboard has capitals, accents and digits.

  • Add game

    It is the first card when the library is empty. Select A folder of games for your recompiled games.

  • Online information

    Wikipedia and Wikidata receive the project’s public URL, not your data. The Steam store does not receive that URL.

Fixed

  • Back after a game on Linux

    Oort returns to the foreground on GNOME. The Linux package is smaller.

  • Back and Settings

    Back works with the mouse, and the first click or tap counts. The selected Settings row matches the page on screen.

Good to know

Install over the old version: games, recompiled-game folders, play time and settings stay.

No games, keys or emulators included. No account or data collection.

On Linux with X11, Oort may return in a window after a full-screen game. Press F11 twice. Wayland keeps full screen.

Not tried yet

Installation and update from alpha.2 were tried on Windows and Linux, with invented games. Not yet tried: Windows 10, a Steam Deck, one real controller from each family, a real touch screen and the real online services.

Install

Windows: x64 for Windows 10 or 11, ARM64 for Windows 11 on ARM. Compare the checksum. The installer is unsigned; SmartScreen may warn.

Linux x64: .deb package for Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and similar.

entry.title: Oort NX 0.1.0-alpha.2 — Find your games again
entry.content:
New

  • Search and favourites

    Press Y on your controller to search. Open a game’s options with + or a long press to add it to your favourites.

Better

  • Controller, keyboard and mouse

    Hints show your controller’s buttons. Use Tab and Enter on the keyboard, or right-click a game to open its options.

  • Small window, large text

    Play stays visible in a short window. Hints wrap onto a second line when needed.

  • Same wording as on Mac

    Oort uses the same labels as on Mac and shows the full credits.

Fixed

  • Back to Oort

    Back from a game’s Android page returns you to Oort. You keep your place even if Android recreates or closes the app.

Good to know

Oort launches nx2android games already installed. It includes no games, keys or engine.

Uninstalling a game deletes its saves: export them first.

No cloud yet.

Not tried yet

194 checks in the emulator (Android 10, 14 and 16) with made-up games. Not tried on a real phone, with a real nx2android game, a real controller or TalkBack.

Install

It installs over alpha.1. You keep your settings.

Android 10 or later. The alpha uses a provisional signing key: the final release will install alongside it.

entry.title: Oort NX 0.5.0-beta.3 — Easier to read, more yours
entry.content:
New

  • The controller in dots

    It lights what you press, in Settings › Controllers, Controls and Players.

  • macOS settings

    Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency are followed.

Better

  • Sentences

    Labels are no longer in capitals, in all seven languages.

  • Readable over art

    The outline has a dark edge and the art darkens behind text.

  • 27 palettes

    Text at 4.5:1 and shapes at 3:1 everywhere.

  • One source

    Colors, spaces, radii and motion come from the same tokens.

Fixed

  • exFAT and FAT32 drives

    Read as full, they refused mods and saves.

  • Add a game

    The steps stayed in English in other languages.

Coming from 0.3.0

Install this DMG once: 0.3.0 cannot move to the new identity by itself. After that, updates are automatic again.

On first launch your library is copied and every file checked. The old one is not modified. Do not open both versions at the same time.

Sign in to your services and grant the macOS permissions once more. No game to recompile.

Not tried yet

Automated tests pass. The controller changes with a real controller, a real game launch, a real Google Drive transfer and another Mac were not tried with this version. Keep a copy of what matters to you.

Install

macOS 26 or later, Apple silicon. The app is not signed by Apple: the first time, use System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway.

entry.title: Oort NX 0.1.0-alpha.2 — Steam, icons and a welcome
entry.content:
New

  • Icon and details

    A program you add gets its icon, name, publisher and version, read in its own file. So do the ones from alpha.1.

  • Steam games

    Installed games, on every drive, with their pictures. Steam starts them, Oort counts the time.

  • Guided setup

    Five short steps, with a controller or a keyboard, to skip or take up later.

  • Information online, if you say yes

    Cover, description, year, genres. Off until you choose.

Better

  • The empty screen and the + tile

    Clearer than before.

Good to know

Run the new installer over the old one: your library, play time and settings stay.

No game, key or emulator is included. No data is collected, no account.

Wikipedia limits anonymous requests: in practice, the Steam store answers most of the time.

Not there yet: Steam achievements, other stores, automatic updates, mods, the Home button in a game.

Not tried yet

Tried on fresh GitHub machines, with invented games, an invented Steam and invented services, the update from alpha.1 included. Not tried: the real Steam, the real online services, a real controller, Windows 10, a real graphics card, a Windows Steam game run by Proton.

Install

Windows: the installer is not signed. Compare the checksum, then “More info” and “Run anyway”. It installs for your account, without administrator rights.

Linux: .deb package for Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and similar.

entry.title: Oort NX 0.1.0-alpha.1 — Oort in your pocket
entry.content:
New

  • Featured

    Swipe the cover; Play stays under the thumb.

  • Library

    Your installed games, sorted your way.

  • With a controller

    Phone on its side: full screen, and buttons drive everything.

  • Controllers in dots

    They light what you press.

  • The four voices

    The sounds Oort makes.

  • No permission

    No network, no files. Nothing is collected.

Good to know

Oort contains no game, no key and no engine: the engine is inside each game.

A game’s settings and saves stay in its own pause menu: Android keeps those files from Oort.

Uninstalling a game happens on its Android page and deletes its saves: export them first.

Not there yet: search, vibration, cloud library.

Not tried yet

Tried in an emulator (Android 10, 14 and 16), with invented games. Not tried: a real phone or tablet, a real nx2android game, a real controller, sound by ear, TalkBack, smoothness and battery.

Install

Android 10 or later. The alpha’s signing key is provisional: the final version will have another identifier, and the alpha will have to be uninstalled.

entry.title: Oort NX 0.1.0-alpha.1 — Oort leaves the Mac

  • Your library

    Recompilations that come with a recomplauncher.json, and any program with its arguments.

  • Start and follow

    Play time, the end of a session, a crash explained and the way back to Oort.

  • With a controller

    Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo, on-screen keyboard included. The controller’s name shows on the home screen.

  • The cloud and the 27 palettes

    The same colors as on the Mac, from 80 to 125%.

  • Two-level settings

    Tried at once, then kept or dropped.

  • The four voices

    The sounds Oort makes.

Good to know

No game, key or emulator is included, and Oort downloads none. No data is collected.

Not there yet: copying a game’s files into its folder, mods, key bindings, the Home button in a game, wallpapers, automatic updates.

Uninstalling leaves your library in place.

Not tried yet

Tried on fresh GitHub machines (Windows Server 2025 and Ubuntu 24.04), with invented games: install, library, settings, launch, coming back, uninstall. Not tried: a player’s PC, a real controller, a real game, Windows 10, a real graphics card, sound by ear.

Install

Windows: the installer is not signed. Compare the checksum, then “More info” and “Run anyway”. It installs for your account, without administrator rights.

Linux: .deb package for Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and similar.

entry.title: Oort NX 0.1.0-alpha.1 — Oort on iPhone and iPad
entry.content:
New

  • Featured

    A large cover to swipe, Play under the thumb.

  • iPhone on its side

    Two panes, and full screen with a controller.

  • iPad

    Tabs at the top, a two-pane game page.

  • Controllers in dots

    Try your buttons and set them, for every game or just one.

  • Options per game

    Picture, data, saves, cheats and shortcut.

  • Offline

    No account, nothing is collected.

Good to know

The app loads games compiled as .framework and signed with your Apple account. Oort on Mac cannot make them yet.

The part that reads and starts games is adapted from NX2Apple (MIT license). Thanks to its authors.

There is no game, no key and no engine in the app.

Not tried yet

Tried in a simulator (iOS 27.2, iPhone and iPad), with made-up games. Not tried: a real device, signing with AltStore or SideStore, iOS 26, a real game, a real controller, sound, VoiceOver, battery.

Install

iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. The IPA is not signed: add it with AltStore or SideStore and your Apple account. A free account asks you to sign again every seven days.

entry.title: Oort NX 0.3.0 — Arcane becomes Oort NX
entry.content:
New

  • The Oort theme

    Dark by default if no theme was chosen, with two icons: Halftone or Particles.

  • The game display

    Choose the display your games open on, for all of them or just one.

Better

  • Interrupted transfers

    The reason and “Resume” stay visible after the alert.

  • Full disk

    The volume is named and the original copy kept.

  • Reference library

    A confirmation before an installed app is replaced.

Fixed

  • One reason, once

    The cloud panel no longer repeats a failure already shown.

Good to know

Recompile Pokémon Legends: Z-A so that the + button goes straight to the game. Choosing the display also needs a game compiled with a compatible engine.
